cohort: 82 neonates admitted to the NICU with seizures or who developed seizures during their stay.
finding: Birth asphyxia was the main etiology identified for neonatal seizures.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was more common than cesarean section among neonates with seizures, but the distribution of neonates by mode of delivery was not statistically significant.
followup_time: Variable, up to 32 days (interquartile range 1-32 days, mean 14.34 days)
